_comment: Provider-agnostic structural validation rules. Applied to every extracted invoice line regardless of which AI provider or pdfplumber produced it.
_outstanding_amount_note: outstanding_amount deliberately removed from required_fields 2026-08-23 (INV-04 amendment, see docs/INVARIANTS.md) -- a blank amount is no longer a reason to divert a row away from Bronze/Silver at extraction time. Whether a blank-amount row is a real exception is now the matching engine's decision (src/matching/engine.py), not extraction's.
